basic_details.job_title: DHS Pudukkottai Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 14 Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Health Society, Pudukkottai District (Health & Family Welfare Department) is filling 14 Contractual / Temporary Staff Nurse posts, on contract basis / purely temporary in nature, in Primary Health Centres, Government Hospitals and Pudukkottai Government Medical College. Applicants need GNM / B.Sc. Nursing with valid Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration and must be up to 50 years of age. Applications are accepted from 23 November 2026 and must reach the District Health Office by 5.00 PM on 4 December 2026, in person or by post.

how_to_apply: Download the application form and details from the district website, https://pudukkottai.nic.in.
Fill in the application and sign it. Only applications with original signatures will be accepted, and the telephone number must be written on the application.
Enclose self-attested photocopies of the relevant documents (listed below).
Send the application by post, or hand it in person, to: The District Health Office, Old Bus Stand near, Court Opposite, Madurai Road, Pudukkottai District - 622 001.
The application must reach this address on or before 4 December 2026 at 5.00 PM.

Prior applications will not be considered. Applicants who applied earlier must reapply within the official window, 23 November 2026 to 4 December 2026, 5.00 PM. Only applications received within this period will be examined.
SSLC Mark Sheet, XII Mark Sheet, Degree/Diploma Mark Sheet, TN Nursing Council Registration Certificate
Nativity Certificate Proof (Aadhar Card / Ration Card / Voter ID Proof)
Any special category certificate (Transgender / Ex Service man / Destitute Widow, Disability Certificate)
important_instructions: The posts are on contract basis / purely temporary in nature. The number of vacancies is subject to revision as per DHS, Pudukkottai. Only applications received within the given period will be examined.

content_sections.heading: About DHS Pudukkottai
content_sections.text: District Health Society, Pudukkottai is the district health body of Pudukkottai District in Tamil Nadu, working under the Health & Family Welfare Department. The Tamil text of the notice links these posts to the National Health Mission (NHM) scheme and to comprehensive emergency obstetric and newborn care centres, including SNCU and PICU. The notice is signed by the District Collector and Chairperson of the District Health Society, and by the District Health Officer and Executive Secretary of the Society.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The age limit is up to 50 years. The notice does not print an age cut-off date or any age relaxation. The notice does not mention experience. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

rows.qualification_required: GNM / B.Sc., Nursing from a Government or Government approved Private Nursing College, recognized by the Indian Nursing Council. Valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.

faq.question: Q1. How many Staff Nurse vacancies are there in DHS Pudukkottai?
faq.answer: There are 14 Contractual / Temporary Staff Nurse vacancies in the district, and the notice says the number is subject to revision.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the District Health Office on or before 4 December 2026 at 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: GNM / B.Sc., Nursing from a Government or Government approved Private Nursing College recognized by the Indian Nursing Council, with valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Download the form from https://pudukkottai.nic.in, sign it, enclose self-attested photocopies, and send it by post or bring it in person to the District Health Office, Madurai Road, Pudukkottai.

faq.question: Q6. Which documents must be enclosed?
faq.answer: The notice names SSLC and XII mark sheets, Degree/Diploma mark sheet, TN Nursing Council registration certificate, nativity proof, community certificate, conduct certificate and any special category certificate.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the notice describes the post as contract basis / purely temporary in nature.

faq.question: Q8. I applied before 23 November 2026. Do I need to apply again?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says prior applications will not be considered and applicants must reapply between 23 November 2026 and 4 December 2026, 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q9. Is a signature and phone number required on the application?
faq.answer: Yes. Only applications with original signatures will be accepted, and the telephone number must be mentioned on the application.
